status: File-service migration active; open options/results complete and verified.

open.options: Scoped byte-width access and sharing enums; named create/truncate/exclusive/native booleans replace positional integers. The file service still owns path validation, native/stream selection, sharing and resource admission.
open.result: Transient result holds a signed 16-bit token (or -1) and missing flag. The registry owns every accepted token; errno remains the failure detail. Returned structs never enter saved records.
open.mode_boundary: MdOpenFlags retains its explicit unsigned 16-bit ABI/layout. StreamOpen decodes access, sharing, create/truncate and no-error policy once at the game/platform boundary. Retry timing, missing/nonmissing admission, error publication and handle assignment remain unchanged. Unrecognized sharing-bit combinations preserve their prior deny-none behavior.
open.effects: OutputFileString retains its existence check and create/truncate/append order. StarsCopyFile retains exclusive create and cleanup. The SDL OpenFile adapter still opens without truncation, validates identity/sharing, then truncates. Lower stream-mode parsing, exclusive creation, native identity and session token reuse/destruction retain their behavior.
open.tests: Before migration the actual token API passed read-only access, update without truncation, create with truncation, and OutputFileString append/new-file checks. The same assertions use named options/results afterward. Existing Unicode/missing/malformed-path, exception, session cleanup and file-service contract checks remain; invalid typed access still rejects before mutation.
open.initial_build_correction: The full build found one SDK OpenFile adapter call omitted from the first src/tests inventory. Its actual named request preserves check-before-truncate order; the inventory now includes compat/win32/src. An initial Windows build command also used the wrong contract target; corrected to stars-test-fileio.
open.test_harness: The actual Windows host build exposed an existing test-only cleanup branch requiring unavailable SDK declarations. Native path-test cleanup now uses std::filesystem with char8_t input and an error_code on every platform, retaining the removal assertion without SDL or SDK conversion scaffolding.

Final builds/tests cover all corrections.
